description: This PHP source file defines the `AttendanceDao` class which is part of the OrangeHRM system. The class interacts with the database to manage attendance records, including saving punch records, checking overlaps, retrieving attendance reports, and handling related workflows. It utilizes Doctrine ORM for query building and supports various attendance-related operations and data retrieval functions.

classes.name: AttendanceDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for handling attendance records, including CRUD operations, overlap checks, reporting, and workflow configuration queries within the OrangeHRM system.
